item.text: The cause is in `#inlineTokensInner`: it builds the emphasis mask over the entire line before code spans are tokenized. Its escape mask therefore treats a backslash inside code as an escape that can affect emphasis after the closing backtick. I’m changing that mask pass to skip valid code spans while keeping its character positions aligned.
